lesson.title: Checkpoint: Was ist passiert?

sentences.text: Sara fragt Mina im Büro: „Was ist heute Morgen passiert?“
sentences.natural_meaning: Sara asks Mina at the office, “What happened this morning?”

verb_help.usage: The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
passiert is the past participle of passieren; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.

items.english: Sara asks Mina at the office

sentences.text: Mina sagt: „Mein Bus hatte Verspätung, weil auf der Straße ein Unfall war.“
sentences.natural_meaning: Mina says, “My bus was delayed because there was an accident on the road.”

verb_help.usage: The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
This is a simple-past form. In speech it is especially common with sein, haben, and modal verbs.

sentences.text: Danach hat sie im Büro angerufen und sich für die Verspätung entschuldigt.
sentences.natural_meaning: Afterwards she called the office and apologized for the delay.

verb_help.usage: The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
angerufen is the past participle of anrufen; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.
entschuldigt is the past participle of entschuldigen; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.

items.german: Danach hat sie … angerufen und … entschuldigt
items.english: Afterwards she called the office and apologized for the delay

sentences.text: Deshalb haben sie den Termin auf den Nachmittag verschoben.
sentences.natural_meaning: Therefore they moved the appointment to the afternoon.

sentences.natural_meaning: Mina was nervous nevertheless, but fortunately everything is clear now.
